trans-unit.source: Bal nikada nije bio samo ples.
trans-unit.target: A ball was never just a dance.

trans-unit.source: Reč postoji od 12. veka, od latinskog ballare — igrati.
trans-unit.target: The word dates back to the 12th century, from the Latin ballare — to dance.

trans-unit.source: Tako su prostori za susret postajali više od prostora.
trans-unit.target: That is how places of encounter became more than places.

trans-unit.source: Postajali su mesta na kojima se gradila kultura, povezivali ljudi i stvarale ideje koje su trajale mnogo duže od jedne večeri.
trans-unit.target: They became places where culture was built, people were brought together and ideas were born that lasted far longer than a single evening.

trans-unit.source: Bio je to način da se ljudi sretnu, različite kulture približe i da iz jednog susreta nastane nešto što će trajati.
trans-unit.target: It was a way for people to meet, for different cultures to draw closer, and for something lasting to grow out of a single encounter.

trans-unit.source: Sretenjski bal u Mariboru nastaje sa istom idejom — kao susret srpske i slovenačke kulture i kao početak jedne nove tradicije.
trans-unit.target: Sretenjski bal in Maribor is born of the same idea — as an encounter of Serbian and Slovenian culture and the beginning of a new tradition.
Kragujevac, the court of Prince Miloš

trans-unit.source: Prvi bal u Kneževini Srbiji održan je 1834. u Kragujevcu, na dvoru kneza Miloša.
trans-unit.target: The first ball in the Principality of Serbia was held in 1834 in Kragujevac, at the court of Prince Miloš.

trans-unit.source: Kroz decenije koje su usledile, balovi su bili mesta susreta, razgovora, povezivanja i dogovora. Na njima su se susretali ljudi iz sveta politike, kulture, privrede i umetnosti, a dobrotvorni balovi prikupljali su sredstva za škole, društva i druge javne potrebe.
trans-unit.target: Over the decades that followed, balls were places of meeting, conversation, connection and agreement. People from politics, culture, business and the arts met at them, while charity balls raised funds for schools, societies and other public needs.

trans-unit.source: I u slovenačkim zemljama ples je odavno bio deo građanskog i društvenog života, ali se do tada balska kultura razvijala u okviru tadašnjih građanskih krugova, često pod snažnim nemačkim i austrijskim kulturnim uticajem.
trans-unit.target: In the Slovenian lands too, dance had long been part of civic and social life, but until then ball culture had developed within the civic circles of the time, often under strong German and Austrian cultural influence.

trans-unit.source: Od šezdesetih godina 19. veka počinje da se razvija mreža slovenskih čitalnica.
trans-unit.target: From the 1860s a network of Slovenian reading rooms (čitalnice) began to develop.

trans-unit.source: Kada je 1863. otvorena čitalnica u Kranju, nakon izvođenja pesme „Hej Slovani“ otpočeo je ples kojim je svečanost i završena.
trans-unit.target: When the reading room in Kranj opened in 1863, the performance of the song “Hej, Slovani” was followed by a dance that closed the celebration.

trans-unit.source: Čitalnice su predstavljale prostore u kojima se nisu samo čitale knjige, već se okupljalo, slušala muzika, održavale predstave, predavanja i, naravno, plesalo.
trans-unit.target: Reading rooms were spaces where people did not only read books but gathered, listened to music, staged plays and lectures and, of course, danced.

trans-unit.source: U Mariboru je ta ideja dobila svoj dom
trans-unit.target: In Maribor, this idea found its home

trans-unit.source: Godine 1898. podignut je Narodni dom, središte kulturnog i društvenog života mariborskih Slovenaca. Pod njegovim krovom našli su se čitaonica, biblioteka, muzička i dramska društva, dok su se u svečanoj dvorani održavali koncerti, predstave, skupovi — i plesovi.
trans-unit.target: In 1898 the Narodni dom was built, the centre of cultural and social life of Maribor's Slovenes. Under its roof were a reading room, a library, and music and drama societies, while the ceremonial hall hosted concerts, plays, gatherings — and dances.

trans-unit.source: Bal nikada nije bio samo ples: od latinskog ballare, preko prvog bala u Kragujevcu i slovenačkih čitalnica, do Narodnog doma u Mariboru.
trans-unit.target: A ball was never just a dance: from the Latin ballare, through the first ball in Kragujevac and the Slovenian reading rooms, to the Narodni dom in Maribor.

With one encounter.With one evening.With one idea.

trans-unit.source: Iza prvog Sretenjskog bala stoji Kulturni centar Sretenje — organizator bala i inicijativa nastala sa željom da se ponovo otvori prostor za pomalo zaboravljenu građansku kulturu i vrednosti koje je ona nosila.
trans-unit.target: Behind the first Sretenjski bal stands the Sretenje Cultural Centre — the organiser of the ball and an initiative born from the wish to reopen a space for a somewhat forgotten civic culture and the values it carried.

trans-unit.source: Kroz istoriju, srpska zajednica na ovim prostorima ostavljala je trag kroz kulturu, obrazovanje, privredu i duhovni život. To nasleđe želimo da približimo savremenom trenutku — ne kao povratak u prošlost, već kao temelj za ono što tek možemo da gradimo.
trans-unit.target: Throughout history, the Serbian community in these lands left its mark through culture, education, the economy and spiritual life. We want to bring that heritage closer to the present — not as a return to the past, but as a foundation for what we can still build.

trans-unit.source: Kulturni centar Sretenje zamišljen je kao trajno mesto susreta ljudi iz sveta kulture, nauke, privrede i duhovnog života. Mesto razgovora, povezivanja i novih ideja. Prostor u kom se neguje sopstveno nasleđe, ali i gradi odnos sa kulturnom sredinom u kojoj živimo.
trans-unit.target: The Sretenje Cultural Centre is conceived as a lasting meeting place for people from culture, science, business and spiritual life. A place of conversation, connection and new ideas. A space where we nurture our own heritage while building a relationship with the cultural environment in which we live.

trans-unit.source: Zato što je u njegovoj osnovi — susret. Susret duhovnog i građanskog. Tradicije i savremenosti. Našeg nasleđa i kulture u kojoj živimo. Verujemo da upravo iz takvih susreta nastaju novi mostovi.
trans-unit.target: Because at its heart lies an encounter. An encounter of the spiritual and the civic. Of tradition and modernity. Of our heritage and the culture in which we live. We believe that new bridges are born precisely from such encounters.

trans-unit.source: Sretenjski bal je naš prvi korak.
trans-unit.target: Sretenjski bal is our first step.

trans-unit.source: Satnica je okvirna i biće potvrđena.
trans-unit.target: The schedule is provisional and will be confirmed.

trans-unit.source: Neke večeri ostaju zauvek u sećanju. Neke postaju tradicija.
trans-unit.target: Some evenings stay in memory forever. Some become a tradition.

trans-unit.source: Krajem 19. veka, u Mariboru u kojem su Slovenci bili manjina, nastala je ideja o prostoru koji će čuvati slovenački jezik, kulturu i zajedništvo. Iz te ideje rođen je Narodni dom.
trans-unit.target: At the end of the 19th century, in a Maribor where Slovenes were a minority, the idea arose of a space that would safeguard the Slovenian language, culture and community. From that idea the Narodni dom was born.

trans-unit.source: Mesto sa istorijom susreta, za početak jednog novog.
trans-unit.target: A place with a history of encounters, for the beginning of a new one.

trans-unit.source: Dom počinje sa radom 1. oktobra, po projektu češkog arhitekte Jana Vejrycha, u stilu češke neorenesanse.
trans-unit.target: The Dom opens on 1 October, designed by the Czech architect Jan Vejrych in the Czech neo-Renaissance style.

trans-unit.source: U velikoj dvorani osnovano je Slovenačko pozorište u Mariboru.
trans-unit.target: The Slovenian Theatre in Maribor was founded in the great hall.

trans-unit.source: U Domu je osnovan Narodni savet za Štajersku.
trans-unit.target: The National Council for Styria was founded in the Dom.

trans-unit.source: Narodni dom ponovo postaje kulturni centar grada.
trans-unit.target: The Narodni dom once again becomes the cultural centre of the city.

trans-unit.source: Reč bal potiče od latinskog ballare — igrati. Balovi su vekovima bili mesta susreta, razgovora, povezivanja i dogovora, a dobrotvorni balovi prikupljali su sredstva za škole, društva i druge javne potrebe.
trans-unit.target: The word ball comes from the Latin ballare — to dance. For centuries balls were places of meeting, conversation, connection and agreement, and charity balls raised funds for schools, societies and other public needs.
The story of the ball tradition

trans-unit.source: Reč sretenje u srpskom i slovenačkom jeziku znači susret, a jedan praznik simboliše toliko susreta.
trans-unit.target: In both Serbian and Slovenian the word sretenje means encounter, and a single feast symbolises so many encounters.

trans-unit.source: Vere i istorije.Zime i proleća.Prošlosti i budućnosti.
trans-unit.target: Of faith and history.Of winter and spring.Of past and future.

trans-unit.source: Sretenjski bal nastaje sa idejom susreta srpske i slovenačke kulture.
trans-unit.target: Sretenjski bal arises from the idea of an encounter between Serbian and Slovenian culture.

trans-unit.source: Prema Jevanđelju po Luki, četrdesetog dana po rođenju, Marija i Josif donose Isusa u jerusalimski hram, gde ga starac Simeon uzima u naručje i prepoznaje kao svetlost.
trans-unit.target: According to the Gospel of Luke, forty days after his birth Mary and Joseph bring Jesus to the Temple in Jerusalem, where the elder Simeon takes him in his arms and recognises him as the light.

trans-unit.source: U narodu se Sretenje vezuje za simbolični susret zime i proleća.
trans-unit.target: In folk tradition, Sretenje is tied to the symbolic meeting of winter and spring.

trans-unit.source: Na Sretenje u Orašcu je podignut Prvi srpski ustanak, kojim je započeta borba za oslobođenje Srbije od osmanske vlasti.
trans-unit.target: On Sretenje the First Serbian Uprising was raised at Orašac, beginning the struggle to free Serbia from Ottoman rule.

trans-unit.source: U Kragujevcu je proglašen Sretenjski ustav. Njime su prvi put jasno postavljeni temelji moderne srpske države.
trans-unit.target: The Sretenje Constitution was proclaimed in Kragujevac. It laid, for the first time, clear foundations of the modern Serbian state.

trans-unit.source: Sretenje je Dan državnosti Republike Srbije.
trans-unit.target: Sretenje is the Statehood Day of the Republic of Serbia.
